scientific_integrity: Complete derivation from binary-digit recurrences and explicit pair-realizing indices; finite program checks do not constitute the infinite proof. Published 2024 paper already notes the ell=3 identity, which is not claimed as a new instance.
scientific_limitations: Only binary-digit sums modulo integer ell>=3 and ordinary letter-preserving reversal; excludes ell=2 and other bases. The factor-complexity formula beyond n=3 is supplied by prior literature, not independently recomputed here. Prior-art search cannot eliminate unindexed equivalent sources.
title: Sharp reversal cutoff and reflection complexity for generalized Thue–Morse words
